title: Lesson 3. You are what you wear
subtitle: Одежда, описания и артикли с названиями одежды

sections.title: 1. Clothes vocabulary
sections.text: {Baggy} clothes are loose; {tight} clothes fit closely. {Trendy} clothes are fashionable; {old-fashioned} clothes are not. {Smart} clothes are for special occasions; {everyday} clothes are for ordinary days. A {checked} shirt has squares; a {striped} shirt has lines. A {belt} goes round your waist; a {tie} goes under a shirt collar. {Trainers} are sports shoes. There is no singular form of {clothes}: we say {a piece of clothing} or {an item of clothing}.

sections.title: 2. Articles with clothes
sections.text: With singular countable nouns we use {a / an}: {a} T-shirt, {a} belt, {a} tie. With {plural} nouns we use {no article}: jeans, trousers, trainers, socks. When the object is known to the reader or listener, we use {the}: {The} trainers she is wearing are very trendy. We do not use a / an with {plural} and {uncountable} nouns. Some clothes words are always plural: {trousers}, {jeans}, {shorts}, {pyjamas}. To count them we say {a pair of} trousers.
chain: a pair of trousers / jeans / trainers

sections.title: 3. Describing clothes
sections.text: He is wearing {a pair of} trainers, a {striped} T-shirt and {baggy} shorts. I like his {belt} because it looks {smart}. I don't like these jeans because they are {too tight}. Today I'm wearing {trousers} and a {checked} shirt. She always buys {trendy} brands. Since the beginning of the school year I've lost two T-shirts, {a tie} and a pair of trainers.

flashcards.a: a / an: a belt, an item of clothing.

flashcards.q: Нужен ли артикль a / an с jeans, trousers?
flashcards.a: Нет: это множественное число. Говорим a pair of jeans.
Когда предмет известен слушателю: The trainers she is wearing are trendy.

I can't wear … tight jeans any more.
